sloka: स्वस्ति प्रत्यागते रामे पुरीमिक्ष्वाकुपालिताम् ।काLइन्दीमथ सीता तु याचमाना कृताञ्जलिः ॥२-५५-२१॥
transliteration: svasti pratyāgate rāme purīmikṣvākupālitām ।kāLindīmatha sītā tu yācamānā kṛtāñjaliḥ ॥2-55-21॥

translations.english: While Sita with her fair complexion was thus invoking river Yamuna with folded hands they reached the southern bank.
